In this lecture we are going to look at different types of arrays in JavaScript.
In JavaScript, arrays can store and manage different types of data.
Let's explore some common types of arrays and the real world application.
Now the first type of array is one dimensional array, which is a single dimensional array.
A single dimensional array is a simple list of items.
Each item has a unique index number starting from zero.
A one dimensional array is the one which has a single row and multiple columns.
As it's shown over here, it can be easily seen that here we have multiple number of columns and one
row.
The real world example can be a list of your favorite movies, for example like this.
So the single array example in JavaScript is going to be like this.
Single dimensional arrays are commonly used for organizing and managing the list of items like movie
names, usernames, or product names.
Now the next type of array is multi-dimensional array.
Multi-dimensional arrays are the arrays within the arrays They are used to represent more complex structures
like tables, matrices, and grids.
Consider a chessboard where each cell contains a chess piece or empty.
So this is a two dimensional array representing the grid.
Multidimensional arrays can represent various grid based data structures like game boards, spreadsheets,
or images where cell or pixel contains the specific data.
Now the next type of array is arrays of objects.
Arrays can store objects which are collection of key and value pairs.
These arrays are useful for organizing and managing the structured data.
Think about a list of students with their names and ages.
So this is an array of objects.
So here again you see that for each cell we have the index starting from zero and continues like this.
Think about a list of students with their names.
So the implementation of this array in JavaScript is going to be something like this.
Arrays of objects are often used to store and manage data from the databases, APIs, or user input.
They can be filtered sorted, transformed based on the specific criteria.
Now the next type of array is array of function.
JavaScript arrays can even store functions, allowing you to manage and execute the multiple functions
in an organized manner.
Imagine a calculator application with multiple operations add, subtract, multiply, and divide this
array of functions.
Arrays of functions can be useful for managing sets of similar operations, such as mathematical functions,
event handlers, or middleware in the web application.
Now the last type of array can be typed arrays.
Typed arrays are a special kind of arrays used for working with binary data.
They provide a fixed size, memory efficient way to store and manipulate large number of numeric data.
Typed arrays can be used for tasks such as processing the large image files, handling audio or video
data, or working with 3D graphics in WebGL.
Typed arrays are often used in high performance or memory intensive applications where precise control
over the data types.
So these are the main types of the arrays in JavaScript.
So hopefully you have an idea of what kind of arrays can we create in JavaScript.
